subject: mathematics
question_text: If one geometric mean g and two arithmetic means p and q are inserted between two numbers, show that g² = (2p − q)(2q − p).

mark_split.label: Write what the two means say

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — say which progression a, p, q, b are in, and what g² equals.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write what the two means say
steps.margin_note: First mark. The examiner wants g² = ab and the four-term A.P. a, p, q, b named. Everything after this is expanding brackets.
steps.memory_tip: Two arithmetic means between the numbers make a chain of four terms with one common difference.
lines: Let the two numbers be a and b
g is the geometric mean between a and b, so g² = ab
p and q are two arithmetic means, so a, p, q, b are in A.P.
Let d be the common difference. Then p = a + d,  q = a + 2d,  b = a + 3d

recall.must_convey: That g² = ab, and that a, p, q, b form a four-term A.P. with p = a + d, q = a + 2d, b = a + 3d.
accept: g squared is a b because g is the geometric mean
a p q b are in arithmetic progression
write p as a plus d and q as a plus two d
rendu arithmetic means unte a p q b A P lo untay
the two means make four terms with one common difference

steps.why: Two arithmetic means inserted between a and b make a four-term A.P., so p and q are both fixed by a single common difference. Writing that down turns the identity into ordinary algebra.
common_mistakes: Treating p and q as two separate arithmetic means of a and b, each equal to (a + b)/2.
Putting a, p, q, b in G.P. instead of A.P., which is the condition for the geometric means question.

steps.label: Simplify 2p − q and 2q − p
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Both simplifications and the closing line ab = g². Show the d terms cancelling — that is the working the examiner reads.
steps.memory_tip: 2p − q gives back the first number and 2q − p gives back the second.

recall.must_convey: That 2p − q = a and 2q − p = b, so their product is ab, which equals g².
accept: two p minus q simplifies to a
two q minus p simplifies to b
the d terms cancel in both brackets
d cancel ipoyi a and b vasthay
their product is a b which is g squared

steps.why: The combinations 2p − q and 2q − p are built so that the d terms cancel and the two original numbers come back. Their product is ab, which the first step already named as g².
common_mistakes: Dropping the bracket and writing 2a + 2d − a + 2d, which leaves a stray 4d.
Stopping at ab without the closing line that ab = g².
